concerns.text: FR-006 requires the pipeline to compute and report the performance gap ΔR² (and ΔMAE, ΔRMSE) between the composition‑only model and a structure‑aware model on a shared test set. Task T008 only generates composition‑only metrics and a baseline‑gap (GNN vs RF); it does not produce the ΔR² metric, leaving FR‑006 unfulfilled.

SC-002 mandates that the ΔR² information‑loss metric be measured and reported. No task in the current list creates a structure‑aware model or computes ΔR², so the success criterion cannot be satisfied.
